method:
PF-5B derived QA records from the evaluation results and the review table (no answer text beyond 120 characters):

* ``cross_document_results.json``: every cross-document question of the four sets (P0 ``cross_document``, P1
  ``cross_document``, held-out ``cross_source``, fresh ``stress`` questions served with more than one source): served or not,
  path, sources and pages per clause, verdict;
* ``procedure_qa.json``: for every served P1, held-out or fresh procedure, section or list, its pages, part count, first and
  last unit, verbatim check and the hand verdict.

    python -X utf8 qa/post_freeze_pf5b/derive.py <results.json> <review table> <qa dir>

questions.question: When must final grades be submitted and how do I transfer them to Banner?
What does the handbook say about plagiarism in research, and how do I check a paper with iThenticate?
How many office hours must faculty hold, and how do I create an assignment in Blackboard?
questions.note: two clauses each verified on its own: handbook p79 (full-time faculty: a minimum of five office hours per week over at least two days) and the complete 'Create an Assignment' section (pages 10-11); no bridge text

questions.question: Within how many hours must instructors submit final examination results, and who approves the grade transfer to Banner?
How many theses can a faculty member supervise at once, and how do I access iThenticate?
questions.note: two clauses each verified on its own: handbook p81 (four theses) and the iThenticate p1 access procedure; no bridge text; Research

questions.question: How many office hours must faculty hold, and how do I access Blackboard?
questions.note: two clauses each verified on its own: handbook p79 (full-time faculty: at least five office hours per week over two days) and the complete p1 Blackboard access procedure; no bridge text

questions.question: How many credit hours is a full teaching load, and how do I send grades to Banner?
questions.note: two clauses each verified on its own: handbook p96 and p91 (12 credit hours per semester; the two statements agree) and the complete p2 send-grades procedure; the guide does not answer the workload clause

questions.question: How many theses can a faculty member supervise at once, and how do I upload a document to iThenticate?
questions.note: two clauses each verified on its own: handbook p81 (four theses) and the complete iThenticate p1 upload procedure

questions.question: What is the student attendance policy, and how do I add attendance in Blackboard Ultra?
How many office hours must faculty hold, and how do I create a scheduled session in Blackboard Collaborate?
How do I send an announcement in Blackboard, and how do I create a discussion in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.note: two clauses, each verified on its own: the complete short-guide announcement section (p9, correct) and the two discussion locations (p1, limited as in M01); no bridge text

questions.question: What does the university require for faculty office hours, and how can I share my office hours with students through Blackboard?
What are the research and publication expectations for faculty, and how do I run my manuscript through iThenticate before submitting it?
What is the university policy on student absences, and how do I record attendance in Blackboard Ultra?
